text: Good application actually but widgets are little bit not usable. When you put one on your desktop and you try to make it smaller it does not. And there are no widgets for tasks. It will be very nice if I'll have a widget with my tasks that I can put on my desktop. And I'd like to see little more organisation of tasks inside application. Because if you don't do any they just disappear end nothing. You just forget the useful tasks because they don't remind you anymore even if you didn't made em.
